content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANGRAU LSPM Part Time Teacher
content_sections.text: Check the official notification and ensure eligibility for the LSPM Part Time Teacher position. Attend the walk-in interview scheduled for 22.10.2026 at Agricultural College, Mahanandi. Register your name before 11:00 AM at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Mahanandi. Carry all original certificates and one set of photo copies of all certificates, publications, and any other relevant documents during registration.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU LSPM Part Time Teacher Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The individual is engaged purely on temporary and contractual hourly basis which will be terminated after completion of the semester or filling of regular staff, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall not have any claim or right to claim for any regular appointment in the University or any government organization. The incumbent shall not have any claim or right for further continuation of contractual service. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification of the candidature at the time of selection or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason thereof. The engaged persons may also leave the contractual service on their own by giving one-month notice, otherwise to be paid one-month salary before leaving. The selected candidates will be required to undergo medical examination at their own expenses as per the rules for ensuring their physical fitness before appointment. The Associate Dean of the College has a right to cancel or postpone the interview for the said position, for the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances or reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at ANGRAU?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the position of LSPM Part Time Teacher on an hourly basis in the Department of Animal Husbandry at Agricultural College, Mahanandi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the LSPM Part Time Teacher position.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 22.10.2026 at 11:00 A.M. at Agricultural College, Mahanandi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.V.Sc. or M.V.Sc. degree to be eligible for the position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women.

faq.question: Q6. What is the remuneration offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 750/- per hour, not exceeding Rs. 27,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at Agricultural College, Mahanandi.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this engagement is purely temporary and contractual on an hourly basis for a period not exceeding 11 months or until completion of the semester or filling of regular staff, whichever is earlier.
